note: Ten everyday dev questions. Same prompts run with and without the caveman rules.

prompts.prompt: My Python function `def add_item(item, items=[]): items.append(item); return items` keeps returning items from earlier calls. Why, and how do I fix it?

My React app on localhost:3000 calls my Flask API on localhost:5000 and the browser says: "blocked by CORS policy: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present". What is happening and how do I fix it?
What is the N+1 query problem in an ORM like Django or SQLAlchemy, and how do I fix it?
Write a debounce function in JavaScript and explain briefly how it works.
I committed to the wrong branch and have not pushed yet. How do I move that commit to a new branch and remove it from the current one?
Explain the difference between TCP and UDP and when to use each.
We put Redis in front of Postgres for product pages and users sometimes see stale prices. What are the main cache invalidation strategies and which would you pick here?
Should I validate email addresses with a regex? If so, give me a sensible one, and tell me what it will get wrong.
My Docker build reinstalls all npm packages every time I change one source file. Why, and how do I fix the Dockerfile?
